visualCharacteristics.purpose: Ruled call-to-action band with a headline, copy and buttons
visualCharacteristics.layout: Headline and copy on the left, button(s) bottom right below a rule
notable: Strong links become primary, em links secondary buttons
small variant sets the headline in the h6 ramp

contentPattern.structure: one cell with a heading, copy paragraph(s) and CTA link paragraphs

usage: Use to prompt a single action such as visiting the job portal or newsroom archive.
reuseGuidance: Fits a short headline, one line of copy and one or two buttons; not for long text or images.
